crossRefs.note: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue; for…
David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything…
Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and…

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
translations.bsb: He retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people.
translations.kjv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
translations.asv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
